rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary public-transport stop or station.

example.english: We’ll get off at the next station.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 jat1 go3 zaam6 lok6 ce1

rows.note: Use this for the radio-station slice of the broadcasting meaning; a television station is usually 電視台.

example.english: This radio station broadcasts news every morning.
example.traditional: 呢間電台朝朝都有新聞報道。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 din6 toi4 ziu1 ziu1 dou1 jau5 san1 man4 bou3 dou6

rows.note: Use this for the police-station slice; a fire station is usually 消防局.

example.english: Have you gone to the police station to report it?
example.jyutping: nei5 heoi3 ging2 cyu5 bou3 on3 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a gas or service station.

example.english: My car is out of gas, so I need to go to a gas station.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4 jiu3 jap6 jau4 zaam6
